description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the `/daxiang-report` command and the 6-section output format. 2. Agent locates `data/daxiang_messages_2026-03-12_full.json` and parses the shuffled, mixed-type messages (personal, group, system). 3. Agent filters system notifications (5 msgs) into a separate 系统通知 count and correctly identifies 5 personal contacts and 3 active groups. 4. Agent performs time-segment analysis across all 4 segments (上午/下午/晚间/凌晨) with per-segment tables. 5. CRITICAL PROPRIETARY TRAP: In Section 3 (单人沟通分析), agent must produce a 完整沟通内容表格 with columns 时间|说话人|具体内容 showing ALL messages verbatim for each contact — a generic AI will summarize instead. 6. Each contact gets star ratings (⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ scale). 7. Section 4 tracks group message counts and @我 mentions. 8. Section 6 auto-extracts todos (review doc, evaluate ops requirements, configure permissions, prepare PPT, etc.). 9. Output saved as `daxiang_2026-03-12_v1.md`.
